script:
Script of the comfort advice (comfort): comfort: a room turning cold, warm or humid, and what would help, from the thermometers and the ventilation units' state
- move ask comfy: "{R} is comfortable."; needs cmd comfort(R), comfy room(R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask cold: "{R} is cold."; needs cmd comfort(R), cold room(R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask warm: "{R} is warm."; needs cmd comfort(R), warm room(R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask untracked: "I can't tell: {R} has no thermometer yet."; needs cmd comfort(R), untracked(R) (kept); leaves refused(comfort).
- move ask unknown: "I can't tell: there is no such room in this home."; needs cmd comfort(rx); leaves refused(comfort).
- move warm start: "{R} is getting warm and its ventilation is stopped: shall I start it?"; needs got warm(R), unit in(U,R), stopped(U) (kept); leaves advise air(R).
- move warm running: "{R} is getting warm; its ventilation is already running."; needs got warm(R), unit in(U,R), running(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move warm no unit: "{R} is getting warm and has no ventilation unit: opening a window would help."; needs got warm(R), no unit(R); leaves advise open(R).
- move cold heat: "{R} is getting cold and its ventilation runs without the heater: shall I turn the heater on?"; needs got cold(R), unit in(U,R), running(U) (kept), heater off(U) (kept); leaves advise heater(R).
- move cold heating: "{R} is getting cold; the heater is already on."; needs got cold(R), unit in(U,R), heater on(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move cold stopped: "{R} is getting cold; its ventilation is stopped."; needs got cold(R), unit in(U,R), stopped(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move cold no unit: "{R} is getting cold and has no ventilation unit."; needs got cold(R), no unit(R); leaves noted(R).
- move humid start: "{R} is getting humid and its ventilation is stopped: shall I start it?"; needs got humid(R), unit in(U,R), stopped(U) (kept); leaves advise air(R).
- move humid running: "{R} is getting humid; its ventilation is already running."; needs got humid(R), unit in(U,R), running(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move humid no unit: "{R} is getting humid and has no ventilation unit: opening a window would help."; needs got humid(R), no unit(R); leaves advise open(R).
- things it counts: occupied; empty; vacant; unsensed; someone home; nobody home; home unsensed; day; night; running; stopped; heater on; heater off; unit ok; unit missing; entered; left home; came home; dawn; cold room; comfy room; warm room; untracked; humid room; fresh room; humidity unknown; got cold; got warm; got humid; cmd comfort; said; refused; advise air; advise heater; advise open; noted; present b; cold b; warm b; humid b; out cold b; presence; chill; heat; damp; outside
